subject: Wrong size hoodie, order OS-3802232
message:
Hello,

I ordered a Claude hoodie in charcoal, size L, on December 23. The order number is OS-3802232. It was delivered on the 29th. When I opened the bag I checked the tag and it says XL, not L. The color is right and it is the same hoodie I picked out, only the size is wrong. My order confirmation shows size L, so the mistake was not on my end. I have not worn it.

Please send me a replacement in size L.

Thank you,
Nancy
